newsitem.title: USA: Shell restarts alkylation unit at Ill. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Shell restarts alkylation unit at Ill. refinery.

text.p: Shell Oil Co restarted a 20,000 barrel per day alkylation unit at its 268,000 barrel per day Wood River, Ill., refinery on Wednesday, a spokeswoman said.

The alkylation unit was idled on Tuesday after a gas plant fire cut its olefins feedstocks, and remained down because of a lack of steam normally supplied by the gas plant, the refinery spokeswoman said.
"We are bringing the alkylation unit back up, and it should be operational just about now," the spokeswoman said at about 1630 CST.
Crews were assessing damage to the gas plant, which is fed by a catalytic cracker. "It's going to be more than a few days" before the unit can be restarted, the spokeswoman said.
The crude rate was trimmed "minimally" following the fire, and will be increased slightly once the alkylation unit is fully operational today, she said.
Midwest refined products prices were largely unaffected by the outage, traders said.
